annotations.title: List the product sets in a Meta catalog

description: The PRODUCT SETS inside one catalog — a set is a slice of the catalog ("summer dresses", "under $50", "everything"), and it is what an AD SET actually advertises. Meta normally auto-creates an "all products" set with every catalog, so an empty list points at the catalog rather than at the request. A set holding ZERO products binds without error and then serves nothing — the ad runs, spends and shows no product — so check the counts. Read-only, 0 credits.

catalogId.description: the numeric catalog id from list_meta_catalogs (a catalog NAME is not an id)
